text: Looper: both loops play at once; the middle left pot is their crossfader and the side it is on records. Each loop has its own stutter, and the Master sampler filter works on the loop mix.
Build status line: the text under the build bar is no longer cut at 260 px; it is shown in full where there is room.
Looper image: Settings has a Looper group with the stutter character (Clean, Glitch low / mid / high), which the loop stutter on the two top pots uses.
Drive (Chebyshev, Fold) is removed from the Compact module: B1 over Output Level does nothing and the Drive destinations are gone from CV and MIDI routing.
Looper image: a converted file can be saved to /LOOPS or put straight into loop 1 / 2; a failed save or load says why (no loop in the slot, no card, busy, write error).
Cloud build: the looper input is sent only for a looper build, so the ordinary build works again on a workflow without it; a looper build says what is missing.
Firmware card: a module built after the latest cloud build (a local build) no longer reads "a newer cloud build exists"; it says it runs a newer build.
Looper image: CV and MIDI routing offer the looper's four destinations (Level, Aux send, Overdub feedback, Loop length) instead of the sampler's start, end, cutoff, transpose and slot.
Looper image: Settings no longer show the sampler auto-record, stutter and record-length controls; the input and clock texts speak of the looper.
Loops on the SD card: each file is a clear two-line row (name and size, then Load, Download, Renumber, Delete); Erase all… asks first. The next number follows the highest file on the card.
SD card: the transfer bar ("Reading …· 100%" with Cancel) no longer stays on screen after a download finishes and blocks the next one.
Looper image: the SD card block lists /LOOPS with Save loop, Load into loop 1 or 2, Download, Renumber and Delete (needs firmware that advertises loopIo).
Looper: B1 + hold B2 saves the playing loop to /LOOPS; B2's LED shows working (cyan), done (green) or failed (pink-red); the first and third pots pick a file for loop 1 / 2.
Sampler stutter: Slice repeat and Slice roll read the sample directly on its cue markers: instant, locked to the break, the pot's note value changes live; roll shortens every repeat.
Sampler stutter: Slice modes (Studio: Sampler stutter). The loop starts exactly on a file's cue marker and the pot picks how much of that slice repeats; files without markers use the clock grid.
Field trace for the sampler and MIDI clock in the HostLink log (512 lines): note timing vs the bar, waits, launches, wraps, silence, playhead jumps, clock stalls.
Tempo tag is written as the tempo at which the clip is exactly whole beats (a 174-named loop of 16 beats in 5.4546 s gets 176.0): the module no longer cuts the last bar off it.
Tempo: a BPM in the file name (also mid-name, e.g. _174_) settles half/double time when the audio agrees; the note shows the audio tempo when it is a little off.
Sampler detector: snares sit on the start of their attack (were up to 17 ms late); hats next to kicks and snares are labelled hat, not snare; the ride and soft hats are kept.
Sampler detector: markers sit at the true start of the hit (sample accurate, just before it); no markers on the click at the end of a kick; markers move in 20 us steps instead of 1 ms.
Sampler stutter mode now lives in the old Sampler Choke settings slot: stored presets stay valid (the first glitch build reset them).
Sampler detector: hats (also right after a snare) are no longer labelled snare; quiet ghost kicks are found.
Sampler stutter: glitch layer, later repeats drop, reverse and bit-crush. Pick Clean / Glitch low / mid / high in Settings > Sampler.
Settings: Mute the other sampler removed (one sampler).
Settings: Firmware card with the module build date, the latest cloud build and this log.
Optional single-stage ADAA Drive trial; a closed Drive reaches true bypass.
Compact sampler: a changed source applies at the next trigger.
Less Compact DSP and sampler seam CPU.
Ping-pong delay: injection side randomized between phrases.
Sidechain: dynamic low-band cut, 2 ms attack, 100 ms release; faint envelope shown at zero depth.
Knob record: shifted recording protected from erase gestures.
